;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**Ahmed Abu Hussein, aged 24, becomes the second journalist killed while covering protests at the Israel–Gaza border. Hussein was hospitalized in Gaza after being shot by [[Israeli Defence Forces]] two weeks prior while wearing a press jacket. [https://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/gaza-news/Palestinian-journalist-shot-by-Israeli-troops-at-Gaza-protest-dies-552733 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs|Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs]] releases a detailed breakdown of [[Palestinian people|Palestinian]] casualties since March 30 by date, age, gender, and injury. A total of 40 deaths and 1,511 injuries are listed. More than 400 injuries are ascribed to [[chemical weapons|gas inhalation]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/palestinians/40-dead-5-511-wounded-un-figures-on-casualties-in-gaza-mass-protests-1.6030556 (Haaretz)]
*The [[Bangladesh]]i [[International Crimes Tribunal (Bangladesh)|International Crimes Tribunal]] sentences former [[National Security Intelligence]] director general Wahidul Haque to prison for [[crimes against humanity]] committed during the [[1971 Liberation War]] when Haque was a [[Pakistani Army]] general. The convictions relate to the deaths of 500–600 unarmed [[Bengalis]] and [[Santals]] in [[Rangpur District|Rangpur]]. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/court/2018/04/25/former-nsi-director-general-sent-to-jail-in-war-crimes-case/ (''The Dhaka Tribune'')]
*[[Rwandan Genocide]]
**Four mass graves are found in [[Gasabo]], [[Rwanda]], thought to date back to the 1994 genocide. Around 3,000 people from the area remain missing. Houses are demolished to access the graves. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-43894989 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Disasters in Indonesia]]
**An oil well catches fire in Ranto Peureulak, [[East Aceh Regency]], [[Indonesia]], killing 28 people and injuring 30. [https://news.sky.com/video/vertical-video-indonesia-fire-002mp4-11345925 (Sky News)] [https://aceh.tribunnews.com/2018/05/24/jumlah-korban-meninggal-akibat-ledakan-sumur-minyak-ranto-peureulak-capai-28-orang (Tribun News)]

;International relations
*[[South Korea–United States relations]]
**[[South Korea]] president [[Moon Jae-in]] announces that he will meet U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] in mid-May. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/04/25/Moon-Trump-to-hold-summit-before-US-North-Korea-talks/7331524642188/ (Upi)]
**It is announced that Admiral [[Harry B. Harris Jr.|Harry B. Harris]] may be nominated as the new [[United States|U.S.]] [[List of ambassadors of the United States to South Korea|Ambassador to South Korea]]. [https://www.military.com/daily-news/2018/04/25/australia-admiral-become-us-ambassador-south-korea.html (Military)]
*Around 500 experts from over 70 countries meet in [[Paris]] to start a two-day counterterror conference discussing methods of cutting financing to [[Al-Qaeda]] and [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]. [http://www.tampabay.com/more-than--nations-hold-talks-on-terror-financing-in-paris-ap_worldbda61a95112d42f4a3ca375f032a4fd5 (''The Tampa Bay Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Politics of Spain]]
**The [[President of the Community of Madrid]], [[Cristina Cifuentes]], resigns after the discovery of a video of her stealing [[anti-aging cream]] in a supermarket and after several weeks of controversy after it came to light that she obtained her master's degree fraudulently. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43891489 (BBC)]
*[[Murder of Kim Wall]]
**[[Denmark|Danish]] inventor and submariner [[Peter Madsen]] is convicted of the murder of [[Sweden|Swedish]] journalist Kim Wall and sentenced to [[life in prison]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43894495 (BBC)]
*[[Joseph James DeAngelo|Golden State Killer]]
**[[Sacramento County Sheriff's Department]] arrest Joseph James DeAngelo in connection to the [[Joseph James DeAngelo|Golden State Killer]] case. [http://theweek.com/speedreads/769504/police-may-have-finally-caught-golden-state-killer (''The Week'')]
*[[Terrorism in Germany]], [[NSU Trial]], [[National Socialist Underground murders|NSU murders]]
**The [[Terrorism|terror]] trial of [[Beate Zschäpe]] hears closing arguments in [[Germany]]. In addition to a series of murders, Zschäpe stands accused of bombings and bank robberies. [https://www.thelocal.de/20180425/mammoth-neo-nazi-terror-trial-enters-final-phase-in-munich (''The Local'')]
*[[Crime in Israel]]
**[[Israel]]i border police officer Ben Deri receives a 9-month sentence for fatally shooting Palestinian teen Nadeem Nawara in 2014. Deri was convicted of causing the unarmed boy's death by negligence. No charges were brought over the shootings of two other teens, one of whom also died. The court heard Deri used live ammunition without authorisation. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/25/israeli-policeman-jailed-fatal-shooting-palestinian-teenager-nadeem-nawara-border-ben-deri (''The Guardian'')]
*[[India]]n [[guru]] [[Asaram Bapu]] is sentenced to life imprisonment for the rape of a child. [https://news.sky.com/story/self-styled-godman-with-millions-of-followers-jailed-for-life-for-raping-minor-11345893 (Sky News)]
*[[Scotland]]'s [[Scottish Parliament|Parliament]] approves a bill [[Scottish devolution|devolving]] authority for [[social care]] payments. The bill arranges staggered introduction with complete devolution by 2021 and formation of a new agency to administer it. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-43885731 (BBC)]
*A [[Turkey|Turkish]] court convicts and sentences thirteen ''[[Cumhuriyet]]'' journalists accused of supporting terrorist organisations. The newspaper is critical of [[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/26/turkey-anti-erdogan-journalists-defiant-convictions-terror-charges (The Guardian)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Reza Shah's mausoleum|Mausoleum of Reza Shah]]
**[[Reza Pahlavi, Crown Prince of Iran|Reza Pahlavi]], former crown prince and son of Iran's last [[Mohammad Reza Shah|Shah]], asked authorities for access to the body of [[Reza Shah]], through trusted doctors and scientific experts. He also added his grandfather must ultimately be buried again in Iran, in a manner that respects the wishes of their [[Pahlavi dynasty|family]] and the Iranian people. [https://www.newsweek.com/iran-mummy-reza-shah-pahlavi-mystery-shah-899257 (Newsweek)]
*[[United States elections, 2020]], [[List of Donald Trump presidential campaign endorsements, 2020|Donald Trump presidential campaign endorsements, 2020]]
**[[Texas]] [[Texas Senate|senator]] [[Ted Cruz]] said he will support [[Donald Trump]] in the 2020 elections. [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/Flash.aspx/416437 (Arutz Sheva)]

;Science and technology
*[[2017 North Korean nuclear test]]
**Scientists from the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] state that [[North Korea]]'s nuclear test site, the [[Punggye-ri Nuclear Test Site]] at [[Mantapsan|Mount Mantap]], would have collapsed just minutes after the country performed its sixth nuclear test and opened up a hole of up to {{convert|656|ft|m}} in diameter. It has been one of the possible reasons given for North Korea agreement to suspend [[List of nuclear weapons tests of North Korea|nuclear]] and [[List of North Korean missile tests|missile tests]]. [http://fortune.com/2018/04/25/north-korea-nuclear-test-mountain-mount-mantap/ (Fortune)]
*A flaw, called the "Ghost in the Locks" exploit, is reported with hotel [[keycard]] systems created by the [[Sweden|Swedish]] lock company [[Assa Abloy]]. The company states that they began deploying a patch in February. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-43896360 (BBC)]
*The [[European Space Agency]] releases the largest-ever 3D map of stars in our galaxy from the [[Gaia (spacecraft)|Gaia spacecraft]]. [http://www.lemonde.fr/sciences/article/2018/04/25/1-692-919-135-etoiles-cataloguees_5290217_1650684.html (''Le Monde'')]
*Astronomers detect light from 14 colliding galaxies. Due to the distances involved, the light comes from events which occurred around 12 billion years ago. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-43841025 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2018 CONCACAF Champions League Finals]]
**[[C.D. Guadalajara]] wins the Champions League title, their first since 1962, by winning in a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shootout]] over [[Toronto FC]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/soccer-insider/wp/2018/04/26/mls-heartbreak-toronto-fc-falls-to-chivas-on-penalty-kicks-in-concacaf-champions-league/ (''Washington Post'')]
